metadata.methodology_note: Counts describe operational system load and flow; they are not individual-level clinical records or official capacity ceilings.

executive_summary: From 2023-01-12 through 2025-12-21, the system recorded an average active care load of 6,232 children and a peak of 11,762 on 2023-12-20. The latest total load was 2,502, while latest net intake was -3. The latest discharge offset ratio was 116.7%. Dataset validation status: Failed (76/100).
